entities.name: Kotori
entities.description: A young Futurist mech pilot, protege of Katsumasa, who becomes the pilot of the Epoch Engine and discovers a kami trapped inside it.

entities.name: Katsumasa
entities.description: A renowned Futurist engineer of Otawara with a telepathic implant, who builds the Epoch Engine and withholds the truth about it from Kotori.

entities.name: Shorikai
entities.description: A kami with a black aura and many hollowed faces, bound by metal spikes and glowing threads inside the Epoch Engine, who takes control of the mech and offers to take their own path with Kotori.

entities.name: Arima
entities.description: Kotori's older friend, a Futurist scientist born outside Otawara, who warns her about Katsumasa.

entities.name: Hideji
entities.description: A pilot quicker in the air than Kotori, but who Katsumasa says lacks composure.

entities.name: Jukai river kami
entities.description: A serpentine kami with a spine of stones and a mane of droplets, bonded to a Jukai woman, which flees through the warped merge.

entities.name: Jukai woman
entities.description: A stout gray-haired kami-bonded member of the Order of Jukai killed by Kotori-Shorikai; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Imperial samurai
entities.description: A kitsune samurai who briefs the raid team and is killed by Shorikai.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A kami invoked in Kotori's oath.

entities.name: Epoch Engine
entities.description: Katsumasa's prototype mech with near-perfect synchronization, secretly powered by a kami.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: A fringe group of nature worshippers and anti-technologists operating from decentralized cells.

entities.name: Veilshapers
entities.description: Professional Futurist spies and agents in layered robes and illusory masks.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The ruling authority of Kamigawa, who participate in the raid.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: Underground gangs of Towashi that the raid claimed to target.

entities.name: Boseiju District
entities.description: The district at the roots of the mighty Boseiju tree where the hideout stands.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The city of Kamigawa below Otawara.

entities.name: Warped merge
entities.description: An unstable meld between utsushiyo, the material realm, and kakuriyo, the spirit realm, left in the hideout wall.

events.summary: Katsumasa shows Kotori the Epoch Engine, a prototype mech, and asks her to pilot it in secret.
events.quote: I call this prime iteration the Epoch Engine—and I want you to be its pilot.

events.summary: Kotori syncs with the mech and feels a flicker of something beneath, then hears the name Shorikai.
Katsumasa brushes aside Kotori's question about the new technology and orders her into daily training.
events.quote: I expect you to be combat ready by the end of the month, understand?"

events.summary: Kotori meets her friend Arima in a coffee house; Arima warns that people say Katsumasa's research is unnatural.
events.quote: They say his research is unnatural."

events.summary: While training at night, Kotori bonds with Shorikai and glimpses a vision of herself killing Katsumasa.
events.quote: Sliding the blade soundlessly into his jugular.

events.summary: Katsumasa assigns Kotori to a supposed Reckoner raid in Boseiju District with Veilshapers and an Imperial samurai.
The team breaks into the building and finds it is a Jukai hideout, not a Reckoner safehouse.
Jukai acolytes burst out with disruptors, and Kotori messages Katsumasa for clarification but receives no reply.
Kotori-Shorikai disable the Jukai fighters, then kill the last Jukai woman by crushing her throat.
events.quote: The woman crumpled to the floor, gurgling blood.

events.summary: A Veilshaper strikes at the river kami and the mech fires a dart without Kotori's command, killing him.
events.quote: The Veilshaper slumped to the floor, a steel dart protruding from a weak spot in his armor, just under his chin.

events.summary: Kotori realizes there is a kami inside the mech.
events.quote: There was a kami inside the mech.

events.summary: Katsumasa, controlling a Veilshaper remotely, tells Kotori to override Shorikai and seize control; she instead lets go.
Shorikai reveals his true bound form and slays the remaining Veilshapers and the samurai.
events.quote: It took only a few more seconds to silence the others, including the injured samurai

events.summary: The river kami escapes through a warped merge left in the wall.
events.quote: Then, the river kami floated into the distorted wall and disappeared.

events.summary: Shorikai speaks to Kotori and proposes they take their own path; Kotori agrees.
Kotori-Shorikai leave the hideout under occlusion veil, fleeing Katsumasa.
events.quote: Kotori-Shorikai left the Jukai hideout and walked into the darkness.

relations.note: her teacher since she was thirteen
relations.quote: He's guided me since I was thirteen, Arima.

relations.note: his prototype for a new generation of mech
relations.quote: My prototype for a new generation of mech.

relations.note: close friends who regard each other as family
relations.quote: they still regarded each other as family.

relations.note: a kami bound inside the mech
relations.quote: There was a kami inside the mech.

relations.note: agree to take their own path together
despise Saiba Futurists and strike their research centers
